metadata.title: Prequential Evaluation of Adaptive Prediction Intervals: A Fifteen-Series Replay Study
metadata.description: A one-step replay study compares residual calibration, adaptive conformal inference and a proportional-integral-derivative style controller with a common Theta-based reference on fifteen selected series. Complete prediction and update traces, sensitivity runs and repeated case constructions document coverage, width and timing under a fixed information order.
metadata.version_notes: Clarifies replay semantics, documents controller sensitivity and repeated constructions, and binds all forecast-before-update trajectories and the standalone manuscript source.
